description: This file defines the interface for Telemetry in the WPEFramework, including methods for reporting, uploading, aborting reports, and managing telemetry opt-out status, along with notification callbacks.

classes.name: ITelemetry
classes.description: Interface for telemetry operations including report management and opt-out controls.

classes.name: ITelemetry::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for telemetry report upload events.

classes.name: TelemetrySuccess
classes.description: Structure indicating success status of telemetry operations.

methods.name: SetReportProfileStatus
methods.description: Sets the telemetry report profile status.

methods.name: LogApplicationEvent
methods.description: Logs an application event with name and value.
